_about: DC Adventures mapping: the complication types the engine may suggest, with fallback wording used when life events don't supply their own. Original content written for DCUGen.

Accident: Has a knack for collateral damage that the insurance companies have noticed.
When things go wrong around {name}, they go spectacularly wrong.
Addiction: Leans on {coffee and pills|a nightly bottle|the thrill of the bet} more than is healthy.
Disability: An old injury limits {them} at the worst moments.
Enemy: Someone from the past wants {name} ruined.
Made a powerful enemy without even noticing.
Fame: Is recognized on the street, which makes discretion hard.
Has a following that turns up at inconvenient moments.
Hatred: Holds a deep, personal hatred that clouds judgment.
Honor: Will not break {their} word, even to a villain.
Won't strike a foe who is down or unaware.
Identity: Has a civilian life that would be wrecked if the truth came out.
Motivation: Driven by something personal that sometimes overrides good sense.
Obsession: Can't let a certain unsolved question go.
Phobia: Has a fear that freezes {them} at the worst times.
Prejudice: Faces suspicion from people who judge by where {they} came from.
Quirk: Has an odd habit that others find unsettling or funny.
Relationship: Someone {name} loves is a constant, vulnerable target.
Reputation: Carries a reputation, deserved or not, that walks into every room first.
Responsibility: Has obligations at home that can't be dropped for heroics or villainy.
Rivalry: Has a rival who turns every encounter into a contest.
Secret: Hides something that would change how others see {them}.
Temper: Loses control when certain buttons are pushed.
Weakness: Has a vulnerability that enemies could learn.
